entities.summary: The Church of the Holy Trinity, known colloquially as the Brothers Hospitallers of Saint John of God Church is a historic Roman Catholic conventual and hospital church of the Brothers Hospitallers of Saint John of God located at 48 Krakowska Street in Kazimierz, the former district of Kraków, Poland.
